Subject: Your breach of contract matter

Dear Mr. Kulkarni,

Thank you for meeting us on 16 July 2021 about your dispute with M/s Patel Infotech Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the goods supplied were defective.

Our advice is to claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract. Please collect the inspection reports and the rejection notices and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
